description: Defines the NewsArticle data model class with serialization/deserialization methods, used for representing news articles within the Flutter project.

classes.name: NewsArticle
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a news article, with fields for headline, image, description, URL, source, publication time, and content. Includes methods for converting to/from database maps and from JSON data from NewsAPI.

methods.name: toDbMap
methods.description: Serializes the NewsArticle instance into a Map suitable for database storage.

methods.name: fromDbMap
methods.description: Creates a NewsArticle instance from a database-record Map.

methods.name: fromNewsApiJson
methods.description: Creates a NewsArticle instance from a JSON object received from the NewsAPI, extracting relevant fields.
